item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03625","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Reports Yeon's 1020 seeds instead of the combined 1660 seeds requested.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correct sum; the second answers with one person's quantity instead of the total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03626","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs of plugs instead of converting to the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 2250000 × 0.02 as 450000 instead of 45000.","reason":"The first stops at the wrong unit of quantity; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written cost expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03627","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 40, but the derivation correctly obtains a 50 mph speed limit.","case2_error":"Counts only one three-second elevator stop despite stops on every floor, incorrectly identifying Lola as slower.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared or different mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03628","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final number 6186 after correctly stating the total-balloon and per-school formulas; the correct answer is 859.","case2_error":"Compares cumulative monthly distances with marathon length instead of checking single-run capacity, yielding four months instead of five.","reason":"The first gives an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second uses the wrong quantity to determine readiness.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03629","case1_error":"Assigns two legs to each of the other walker's dogs in the equation, then unjustifiably rounds 6.5 dogs to seven.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 32 × 12 as 360 instead of 384.","reason":"The first constructs an erroneous legs equation and rounds its result; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
